messages.content: Can Sarah Chen's 15% NS-500 discount for Acme (DR-9001) be approved on 2026-09-23?

The available sources don’t establish whether Sarah can approve DR-9001 on 2026-09-23. The 15% approval limit in the pricing policy applied only through 2025, so it can’t confirm approval authority for 2026. [5] DR-9001 is still marked “Pending Approval.” [2]

Acme’s 2025 agreement and a prior 15% request were cited, but the account strategy says to confirm the preferential pricing with Deal Desk; the sources don’t show that confirmation or a current 2026 approval policy. [3][4]
